description: A React component named VelocityChart that visualizes workflow node durations over time using Recharts. It processes an array of nodes to generate chart data, formats durations and timestamps, and renders an interactive area and line chart with custom tooltips.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric duration into a human-readable string (ms, s, m s).

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a localized time string.
